SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

PAYOUT_RESERVE.details: While this pool's own IMD before the swap (market band, wall, retainClaims) plus a buy's own fee is under this much and the PoolManager cannot pay them, the buy's unfunded payouts join liquidity (2 IMD covers the 1.75% payouts of the largest buy the launch window allows).

RING.details: Two days of hourly slots: the current hour's write can evict only the slot of 48 hours ago, so a day-old reference survives up to 23 quiet hours (round-3 audit R3-A1-1).

T_PRICE_BEFORE.details: The pool's sqrt price before the swap in flight: the hourly checkpoint records it, so the trade that opens an hour cannot choose the hour's reference price.

lastCheckpointHour.details: The hour of the newest checkpoint, so `latestPrice` reads one ring entry, not all 48.

CAP_DECAY_DAYS().notice: The cap may travel from the seeded inventory down to `CAP_FLOOR` in this long at the fastest; the daily allowance is fixed at seed (`capDecayPerDay`). It only ever ratchets down, following the market's holdings on buys and on sells that leave the market under the cap.

CREDIT_RESERVE().notice: Gas kept back around the credit itself (63/64 rule, event, plain-IMD fallback).

MARKET_CAP_IMD().notice: The seed's market cap: 20,000 IMD on mainnet (5,700 on the Sepolia runs).

MSG_SENDER_GAS().notice: Gas lent to a router's `msgSender()` when a swap carries no hookData.

SWAP_RESERVE().notice: Gas a swap must still have when it reaches `beforeSwap`, on top of `creditGas`: the rest of the swap (fees, cap, checkpoints) plus slack. Checked first, so the minimum a gas estimate finds is set here and small state changes before inclusion only eat slack.

WALL_GUARD_TICKS_PER_DAY().notice: How far the wall's placement guard may move toward a higher PLEA price per day (~7.25%).

afterSwap(address,(address,address,uint2.notice: Settles the specified-side fee against the realised fill (refunding the rest), takes the fee on the unspecified currency, delivers the PLEA of an exact-input buy as ERC-20, pays every fee, applies the cap, then pays cashback as the very last step.

beforeSwap(address,(address,address,uint.notice: Gates sells, refuses exact-output buys while the Cabal watches and takes the fee on the specified currency as a share of the fill (settled against the realised fill in `afterSwap`).

capDecayPerDay().notice: Most PLEA the cap may fall per day: (seeded inventory - CAP_FLOOR) / CAP_DECAY_DAYS.

creditGas().notice: Gas given to each Stacker credit. A trade that cannot afford it reverts `NotEnoughGas`, so a gas estimate always includes the credit (Sepolia: a first credit costs about 1.2M).

fundWall(uint256).notice: Anyone may add IMD to the wall's reserve (the gate routes appeal fees here).

latestPrice().notice: The most recent hourly checkpoint (the price at the first trade of that hour).

launchExtraBps().notice: Extra buy fee in bps during the launch window: 70% at seed, 0% after 90 minutes.

pleaClaims().notice: PLEA owed to the burn while a sale's input had not settled yet: ERC-6909 PLEA claims `rebalance` redeems and burns (round 7, R7-A3-1).

price24hAgo().notice: The checkpointed price from at least 24 hours ago (0 when none is old enough).

priceX96().notice: Spot IMD per PLEA, scaled by 2^96. Fact scores never use it (see `latestPrice`).

rebalance().notice: Permissionless: redeems the pool share's claims, settles a filled wall (burning the PLEA it bought) and redeploys all retained IMD as one IMD-only band just below the price. It pays the caller nothing: the wall's IMD never leaves the pool.

retainClaims().notice: Wall reserve held as ERC-6909 IMD claims (redeemed by `rebalance`).

retainedImd().notice: Wall reserve held as IMD by the hook.

seed().notice: Creates the PLEA/IMD pool at the `MARKET_CAP_IMD` market cap (5,700 IMD on Sepolia, 20,000 on mainnet) with the hook's whole PLEA balance as the only liquidity. Once, through PleaLaunch.seed (owner any time, anyone after START).

simd().notice: The sIMD vault behind the Stacker: never a valid cashback recipient.

wallGuardTick().notice: The wall's placement guard (POOL4's deployment floor, mirrored for an IMD bid). It moves at once to any lower PLEA price the pool trades at, and toward a higher one only at `WALL_GUARD_TICKS_PER_DAY`, toward `refTick`. The wall is never placed above it, so lifting the wall to a pumped price means holding that price for days. In raw ticks it is a ceiling on the band's upper tick when PLEA is token0 and a floor on its lower tick when PLEA is token1.

wallImd().notice: IMD the current wall was deployed with (what it has spent so far is `wallImd - imdInWall`).
